verdict.rationale: Wrike's own materials say teams can build custom AI agents that handle triaging, risk assessment, and task execution, and can build workflows with Wrike agents. These are short marketing-level claims with no documentation of how agents are built or configured. MCP connectivity to external assistants is a different capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of the agent builder and its configuration options (instructions, tools, triggers, permissions), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
